title: legacy-map.yaml
description: Legacy raw notes (plan §5): each channel-1 note in a range drives one DMX channel. Note-on sets it to velocity × 2, with velocity 127 giving 255; note-off or a velocity-0 note-on sets it to 0. Optional: a show without this file has no legacy notes.

ranges.description: Note ranges must not overlap. The engine also rejects ranges running past channel 512.

address.description: DMX channel driven by first_note; the next notes drive the next channels.
